near_duplicate_detection_method: Per-crop LSH banding (candidate generation, bucketed by crop so a genuine near-duplicate pair can never span crops) + exact Hamming-distance verification per candidate pair, for aHash/dHash/pHash independently. A pair is only unioned into a group if at least 2 of the 3 hash algorithms agree within their own threshold (reduces single-hash false positives on this dataset's largely uniform 300x300 images); the agreeing signal names and the minimum confirmed Hamming distance are recorded per group. Unioned with SHA-256 exact-match groups. Recall for the per-crop LSH candidate step is guaranteed-complete for Hamming thresholds strictly less than lsh_bands (see lsh_candidate_pairs docstring); configured thresholds >= lsh_bands trade recall for tractability. Buckets larger than 4000 images were skipped for pairwise verification (see oversized_lsh_buckets) as they are almost certainly already covered by SHA-256 exact grouping. NOTE: an earlier version of this pipeline ran LSH globally (not per-crop) and required only 1 signal, which produced a single spurious 8,872-image group spanning all 6 crops via hash-collision chaining through union-find -- this methodology was corrected in response and is documented here for transparency.
